talents.e: Cuts the mana cost of Shock, Lightning Bolt, Lava Burst and Chain Lightning by {2|10}%.
Boosts damage from Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Earth Shock by {1|5}%.
Direct spell crits give a {3|9}% boost to melee crit chance for 10 sec.
Reduces Shock spell cooldowns by {0.2|1} sec.
Cuts the cast time of Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Lava Burst by {0.17|0.5} sec.
Raises damage from Fire Totems, Flame Shock, Fire Nova and Lava Burst by {5|15}%; Flame Shock lasts {3|9} sec longer.
Gives a ten percent chance that your next damage spell is free.
Lowers damage taken from Fire, Frost and Nature effects by {3|10}%.
Fire Nova deals {10|20}% more damage with {2|4} sec less cooldown; Magma Totem lasts {10|20} sec longer.
Gives Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Lava Burst a {23|70}% chance to keep casting when damaged.
Earthbind Totem immobilizes nearby enemies for five seconds when cast.
Adds {3|6} yards to Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova and Lava Burst; Totemic Projection cooldown drops {10|20} sec.
Fire bolt hitting for roughly 150 to 193, stronger on Flame Shocked targets.
Gives Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning a {3|10}% chance to cast a free half-damage copy on the same target.
Gives Searing and Magma Totems and Fire, Frost and Nature spells a {20|100}% critical strike damage bonus.
Shortens Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst casts and frees Chain Lightning's cooldown.
Raises Stoneclaw Totem health by {25|50}% and Earthbind Totem radius by {10|20}%.
Adds {1|5}% critical strike chance to all spells and attacks.
Raises Intellect by {2|10}%.
Stoneskin and Windwall Totems reduce {10|20}% more damage; Grounding Totem cooldown drops {1|2} sec.
Adds Attack Power equal to {33|100}% of your Intellect.
Cuts Ghost Wolf cast time by {1|3} sec and lets you use it indoors.
Lightning Shield orbs deal {5|15}% more damage.
Rockbiter adds {7|20}% melee AP, Windfury gains {13|40}% effect, Flametongue and Frostbrand gain {5|15}% damage.
Cuts Shock and Lightning Shield mana costs by 45 percent.
Adds {2|6}% extra dodge chance.
Raises Stamina by {2|10}%.
After a melee crit, gives {5|25}% attack speed for your next 3 swings.
Instant melee strike that empowers your next lightning or Earth Shock spell.
Adds parry chance; threat changes based on Rockbiter Weapon being active.
Raises spell damage and healing by up to {15|30}% of your Intellect.
Gives a {50|100}% chance of 50% mana regen while casting for 15 sec, and a {50|100}% chance to reset Stormstrike's cooldown on dodge or parry.
Each melee hit has a {4|20}% chance to cut your next Lightning Bolt's cast time and mana; stacks 5 times for 30 sec.
Thirty percent attack speed boost for 25 seconds on a three-minute cooldown.
Cuts Healing Wave cast time by {0.1|0.5} sec.
Cuts healing spell mana cost by {1|5}% and adds {1|5}% hit chance.
Keeps {17|50}% of your mana regeneration active while casting.
Reduces threat from your spells by {5|15}%.
Cuts mana cost of totems and spells that summon or move them by {5|25}%.
Cuts Reincarnation cooldown by {10|20} min, adds {2|4}% max health, and raises reincarnation health and mana by {10|20}%.
After a healing crit, the target gains {8|25}% armor for 15 sec.
Gives healing spells a {23|70}% chance to keep casting when damaged.
Restores mana from hits and healing crits using globes lasting ten minutes.
Adds {1|5}% critical effect chance to healing spells.
Raises Mana Spring Totem effect by {5|25}% and Healing Stream Totem effect by {10|50}%.
Totem pulses 88 mana every few seconds to nearby party members.
Raises the healing of Healing Wave by {8|25}%.
Next short Nature spell becomes instant on a three-minute cooldown.
Increases healing spell effectiveness by {2|10}%.
Heals a target and boosts the next Chain Heal on them by 25 percent.
